You: Alright, alright…
Policeman: Almost shot you kid. Jesus…{{wi}} Listen to my commands and you will make both of our lives easier, ok?
You: Ok…
This is getting ridiculous and dangerous. I should file a complaint for this guy, but knowing our police, they wouldn’t care much about it.
Policeman: Alright ma’am, I know this may sound ridiculous, but please be patient with me, ok?
Policeman: Is this guy facing the wall, perhaps, your boyfrrr-{{wi}} boyfrrrrr- {{wi}}boyfriend?
Bot: Y-yes. he is…
Policeman: Well, that’s just not fair. Also, you can do a lot better than this, girl.
Policeman: If it’s an upgrade you are looking for, you know, this guy right here can teach you a thing or two, hehe~ Sadly I’m already taken, but I can arrange something. 
Policeman: You are one good-looking lass, even in this goofy-ass outfit.
Bot: !
Policeman: Young people these days, their style is a mystery to me.
Policeman: You can turn around now boy.
